title: Learn Swedish at the café: beställa kaffe | SvenskaVardag
text:
How do you order coffee in Sweden? Follow Maja and Sara at a Stockholm café and learn the everyday phrases for ordering, choosing dine-in or takeaway, and paying.

📝 "Hej! Vad får det lov att vara?"
↳ Hi! What can I get for you?

📝 "En bryggkaffe och en kanelbulle, tack."
↳ One filter coffee and a cinnamon bun, please.

📝 "Ska du sitta här eller ta med?"
↳ Will you sit here or take it to go?

📝 "Jag sitter här."
↳ I'll sit here.

🎓 You learn:
• bryggkaffe = filter coffee, the standard café coffee
• kanelbulle = cinnamon bun, the classic fika treat
• ta med = take away (literally "take with")
• Polite ordering with "tack"
